en-US: Build 228 candidate: IDE Office tabs now request the shared document session before opening; PPT edit startup has a bounded extent-based fallback and still requires a painted edit surface. Git actions in a narrow iPad sidebar have touch-sized controls. The IDE Run sheet offers automatic, one-core and two-core guest choices; two-core execution remains unavailable until the SMP guest passes qualification. Selecting a local MLX model now requests confirmation before stopping active Linux guests. Please retest Word/Excel/PPT in IDE tabs, PPT editing in Workspace and Notes, MLX load and benchmark plus ordinary and tool-assisted chat, and the Linux conflict prompt. A cloud build or component pass is not physical-device acceptance; report the actual iPad result.
zh-Hans: Build 228 候选：IDE 的 Office 标签先建立共享文档会话再打开；PPT 编辑启动增加有界的页面范围后备判断，仍须实际绘制可编辑页面。iPad 窄侧栏的 Git 操作改为适合触控的尺寸。IDE 运行面板提供自动、单核、双核选择；双核客体通过资格验证前仍不可执行。选择本地 MLX 模型时，会先确认是否停止正在运行的 Linux 客体。请重点复测 IDE 内 Word/Excel/PPT、工作区和手记的 PPT 编辑、本地模型加载与测速、普通及工具对话，以及 Linux 冲突确认。云端构建或组件测试不代表真机通过，请记录 iPad 的实际结果。
